episodes.title: New Beginnings
episodes.summary: Richard opens a classic car restoration workshop but being the boss of a new business isn't quite what he expected. He ropes in his family to help promote it.

episodes.title: London Classic Car Show
episodes.summary: Richard gambles his own money on a 1970 Mark II Jensen Interceptor with plans to restore it to factory specification. Plus, the guys head to the London Classic Car Show.

episodes.title: Classic Mini
episodes.summary: Richard finds a classic mini that needs restoring. And, with the costs of the new workshop escalating, he sells some of his own cars to help pay for the business.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Some of the precious classic cars and motorbikes go to auction with no reserve. Meanwhile, Neil and Anthony get to work on a mystery vehicle from the 1930s.

episodes.title: The Concours of Elegance
episodes.summary: In an attempt to win work, Richard and the team decide to enter one of their cars into the UK's most prestigious classic car show contest, the Concours of Elegance.

episodes.title: Running on Empty
episodes.summary: Richard's new state-of-the-art workshop is finally open but nearly a quarter of a million out of pocket, the business has got to start paying for itself.

episodes.title: Land Rover
episodes.summary: Richard faces the hard reality that the workshop isn't yet making any money. But a fast turnaround paint job on a Land Rover provides some financial respite.

episodes.title: The Pressure is On
episodes.summary: The pressure is on when Richard decides to compete at an NEC show to bring in clients. Plus, Anthony's unusual repair job has him sourcing spare parts from Sri Lanka.

episodes.title: 1930s Morris 8
episodes.summary: Neil promises to help a friend with his 1930s Morris 8, but it's a financial hit for Cog. Plus, Richard admits to Kamla that work on the MGB will cost more than expected.

episodes.title: Prescott Hill Climb
episodes.summary: Richard takes the Cogs go karting to find a driver for the classic racing team. And, The Smallest Cog MBG GT race car gets its debut at the Prescott Hill Climb.

episodes.title: The Big Bet
episodes.summary: Richard faces a gun-toting client, who is anxious for work to start on his vintage Bentley. And, poor planning threatens The Smallest Cog's chance at a car show.

episodes.title: The Moment of Truth
episodes.summary: Richard comes up with a cunning plan to create a show car to generate business for the Cog. And, Accountant Kamla gives Richard a harsh reality check.

episodes.title: 1950s Alvis
episodes.summary: Richard's team work overtime to complete their first big restoration – a 1950s Alvis. Plus, they are under pressure to get their racing MGB fit for competition.

episodes.title: Where's all the Money?
episodes.summary: Richard must come up with a plan to raise emergency funds. And, the team enter their first race at Donnington Park, but engine problems threaten to derail the entire project.

episodes.title: Going Global
episodes.summary: Richard's business goes global after a call from an international car collector in Singapore. And, Richard helps his best friend Les fulfil a childhood dream.

episodes.title: 1950s Porsche 356
episodes.summary: Richard and the team try to win one of their biggest ever restorations - a rare 1950s Porsche 365. Plus, the team head to Silverstone in search of racing glory.

episodes.title: Busy, Busy, Busy!
episodes.summary: Richard restores a unique 1947 Delahaye sports car belonging to legendary Grand Prix driver Louis Chiron. But with the Delahaye's original paint to track down, Richard soon fears his dream to display the car to the classic car elite may be in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Back in the Racing Saddle
episodes.summary: Richard prepares the MGB for the racing season, and fixes up an E-type for a classic car rally. Kamla is delighted when Richard ups the workshop rate. But the plan is derailed when Neil takes on a rusting Lancia to raise money for endangered leopards.

episodes.title: A Brave New World
episodes.summary: Richard and the Cogs restore a 1947 Delahaye and a Jaguar XK120 for Salon Privé. While Richard explores the future of motoring in a Bentley powered by synthetic fuels at Goodwood, a Lancia taken on to help endangered leopards threatens to derail plans.

episodes.title: Passion Over Profit
episodes.summary: Anthony gets the chance to do driver training in a race-spec Nissan Skyline GTR at Donington Park, but his attempts to repeat the experience in The Smallest Cog's MGB end in spectacular failure.

episodes.title: Crunch Time
episodes.summary: After a disastrous test with the MGB, Richard warns the Cogs if they can't turn things around in time for the next race, he'll pull the plug on the whole project. And Neil struggles to get the Lancia finished in time for a Goodwood auction.

episodes.title: Wheels And Waves
episodes.summary: The cogs go International restoring an iconic 1970s Royal Enfield Interceptor motorbike. An epic road trip ensues when Richard, Neil and Andrew decide to deliver the bike themselves to the cool Wheels and Waves festival in Biarritz.

episodes.title: The Last Race?
episodes.summary: Richard redesigns his horsebox into an RV for the Cog race team but questions whether they should continue racing as the Cogs face their final event.

episodes.title: The End of the Road?
episodes.summary: Richard and the Cogs restore 'Olivia' for a live audience at CarFest. But can the show help the team get their mojo back?

episodes.title: Something Has to Change
episodes.summary: Richard has the chance to win a historical, unique, car restoration project.

episodes.title: A New Era
episodes.summary: Richard brings in a business consultant to revolutionise the business.

episodes.title: Testing Times
episodes.summary: Richard Hammond and the Cogs work on a priceless car from World War Two.

episodes.title: The Cog Needs You!
episodes.summary: The Cog race to make their most important deadline ever.

episodes.title: Pedal to the Metal
episodes.summary: Radio personality Johnny Vaughan has a Maserati in need of attention.

episodes.title: Deadline for D-Day
episodes.summary: It's D-Day for Neil & the workshop. Can they finish Monty's Rolls in time?

episodes.title: Hebbie-Jeebies
episodes.summary: Richard races at Silverstone and has a podium finish within his sights.

episodes.title: D-Day
episodes.summary: Richard faces a business dilemma that could crush his classic car restoration dreams and the Cogs head to France on their most important mission yet, delivering Field Marshal Montgomery's Rolls Royce to Normandy, for the D-Day 80 commemorations.

episodes.title: Super-charging the Cog
episodes.summary: Richard wants to take the business to a whole new level by using the power of social media and embracing his role as Cog brand ambassador, resulting in an intrepid trip to the Middle East.

episodes.title: Tickled Pink
episodes.summary: The Cog respray an Aston Martin Lagonda a shocking pink for Europe's biggest car collector. Richard's daughter Izzy discovers a passion for racing. Richard gets carried away and enters them into a race, prompting a last-minute bout of parental nerves.

episodes.title: Mum Knows Best
episodes.summary: Things appear to be on the up when they land a prestigious Morgan job, but a disastrous E-Type re-build prompts an emergency audit by Richard's mum. The verdict is damning.

episodes.title: H is for Help!
episodes.summary: With the workshop haemorrhaging money, Richard brings in heavyweight help. And attempts to make money through selling merchandise backfire when Lewis massively over-orders stock.

episodes.title: American Dream
episodes.summary: A 1950's American pick-up truck offers the Cogs their first chance of car-show glory, if they can restore it to pristine condition. And Richard gets a shot of driving in the biggest classic car race of the season, providing he can impress his mentor.

episodes.title: Old Mates and Motor-Racing
episodes.summary: Much excitement as the Cogs head to the Isle of Man TT to launch a new British bike brand. A racing Mini needs brutal surgery after a crash. And Hadrian calls time on Cog Racing so Richard enlists old friends Les and Zog as his stand-in race team.

episodes.title: Marshalling the Raw Recruits
episodes.summary: New staff find themselves in at the deep end restoring a unique 1960's concept car and a rare Lotus. Richard follows his dream of big-time racing and attempts to get his hundred-year-old steam car back on the road threaten to run out of puff.

episodes.title: Heading in the Right Direction
episodes.summary: The Cogs take centre stage at Britain's premier car show, but the wheels fall off when Richard returns James May's restored Triumph Stag.
